name: oracle
description: Truth-verification harness with structured research, budget-aware gating, transcript-corpus-derived behavioural guards, and a CodeRabbit-style session-summary checkpoint loop. New in 0.7.0: the firecrawl skill bundle is baked in (14 skills from firecrawl/cli and firecrawl/skills covering CLI use, agent / search / scrape / map / crawl / interact / parse / download, plus four build-* skills for integrating Firecrawl into product code) so installing oracle is enough to give Claude Code full Firecrawl coverage without a separate `npx skills add` step. SessionStart injects a verification protocol. PreToolUse on Bash intercepts unpinned installs across thirteen package managers. PreToolUse on Edit/Write/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit warns when the target path has not been Read within a thirty-minute freshness window (transcript-corpus evidence: ~1,128 'File has not been read yet' / 'File has been modified since read' / 'String to replace not found' errors across 1,186 sessions). PostToolUse on Read records read state. PreToolUse + PostToolUse on the bundled firecrawl-mcp@3.16.0 surface enforce tiered rate-limit gating (silent under 80%, soft remind 80-95%, ask 95-100% or single-call >=15% or rolling-hour over 5000 credits, deny over 100%). UserPromptSubmit + Stop + SessionEnd implement the session-summary checkpoint loop: cumulative agent-active milliseconds accrue on Stop only so user-AFK time is structurally excluded; UserPromptSubmit fires a CodeRabbit-style review every 30 minutes of active work or every 50 turns, with deterministic tool-call counts (files edited/read, bash invocations, tasks, subagent dispatches) plus an LLM narrative + three self-review questions generated by the narrator model selected via /oracle:narrator (defaults to claude-sonnet-4-6; aliases sonnet/opus/haiku; `off` disables the LLM tier). Seven slash commands: /oracle:setup, /oracle:verify, /oracle:research [--intensity=quick|standard|exhaustive], /oracle:vet, /oracle:budget, /oracle:mcp-fleet, /oracle:narrator. Five Opus-4.7-primed subagents: canon-reader, github-archivist, issue-investigator, forum-anthropologist, cost-rethinker. Twenty-one auto-triggering knowledge skills (seven original + fourteen firecrawl). All firecrawl-mcp tools allow-listed across every silo for citation-backed retrieval. Bundled mcp-fleet utility (scripts/mcp-fleet/) handles multi-workspace MCP onboarding via Chrome-profile-isolated OAuth probes; sidesteps the OAuth-token-collision bugs in anthropics/claude-code#39952 and microsoft/vscode#293533. Test suite: shellcheck, JSON syntax, YAML frontmatter, POSIX-test lint, plus per-hook integration tests. Targets ~1,128 read-before-edit errors plus ~300 speculative-path failures plus 676 long-session interrupts observed across the local 1,186-transcript corpus.
